interpretation: CLAP selects an acoustic description; these substantial jewelry redesigns are our artistic correspondences, not decoded animal meaning or Livia's own mappings.
prompt: Transform the supplied jewelry photograph into a dramatically redesigned sculptural ring. Preserve the recognizable natural stone, its material and coloration, the wearable circular finger band, the photographed viewpoint and plain studio background. Completely replace the silver setting with a substantial new silhouette extending outward from the stone. Keep the face of the stone exposed. Use solid cast sterling-silver surfaces, organic asymmetry and rounded finished edges. The stone must remain visibly supported. Make the difference from the original obvious at thumbnail size. The sound-selected design direction is: {operation} Product photograph of the redesigned ring, realistic silver, natural stone, coherent construction, whole object visible. Avoid thin wire cages, enclosing rib frameworks, bars over the stone and extra stones.
neutral: A broad asymmetric silver shoulder with a smooth sculptural surface extending outward from one side of the exposed stone; a freely redesigned organic setting.

clicks.title: Percussive silver terraces
clicks.operation: Break the setting into a bold staggered sequence of five chunky sculptural silver terraces, like overlapping rounded plates stepping outward on one side of the stone. Create deep shadow gaps between the plates, sharp changes in silhouette and a strongly asymmetric rhythm. Attach the plates to the ring shoulder, leaving the stone face open.
clicks.connection: A modular variation of Livia's digitally modeled silver settings, using broad solid plates instead of an enclosing lattice.

whistle.title: Sweeping silver crest
whistle.operation: Replace the small folds with one broad continuous polished silver sweep that rises from the ring shoulder and flares outward into a tall curved crest beside the exposed stone. The crest bends like a flowing leaf, with a smooth long edge and a dramatic asymmetric profile. The crest must project away from the stone rather than wrap around it.
whistle.connection: Extends the curved silver surfaces of Mitoring into a much larger continuous gesture.

wavering.title: Unfurling silver petals
wavering.operation: Unfurl the setting into three large broad rippling silver petals opening outward from the exposed stone. Twist and curl each solid petal in a different direction, with deep saddle-shaped surfaces, scalloped edges and a dramatic organic silhouette. Anchor the petals to the shoulder beneath the stone, opening away from its face.
wavering.connection: Expands Mitoring's folded silver and Mycelium's organic setting into outward opening surfaces.
